items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time.

ctx.x: I mean, they had Paul Barnes and Handy, they didn't have him at the same time. No, Paul Barnes was there before Handy.

I see. Did Handy take over the job, you think? Yes, Handy, I think, uh, Handy comes after Paul, I think. I see. I just wondered if they had a humbug, if he got sick, or what? See, at the time they had, uh, I think, uh, she was playing trumpet then. I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! He was playing trumpet then. I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! Flosie, and Davis on drum. That was that set up. And…
So you stayed there for a while with Handy? Yeah, I stayed at the Levitas, with about eight years. Eight years?
